title: Euroleague Final Four: Real Madrid is the new champion, Andres Nocioni MVP
description: Real Madrid is 2015 Euroleague champion! 78-59 the final score in the final against the two-times recent champions of Olympiakos and ninth title won after the last one in 1995. In a full Barclaycard Center of Madrid (12987 spectators) the hosts led in the score for all the game, with an important partial in the second quarter closing definitively the game in the last 10 minutes. Key of the victory for the men of coach Laso the better percentages by 3 and especially in the free throws (84% against 48% of the Greek team) with a good work also at rebound (40-25). MVP of this Euroleague Final Four Andres Nocioni (202-SF-79), decisive in the last quarter with a performance of 12 points, 7 rebounds and 2 blocks! Across only 3 points for the three-times MVP Spanoulis (1/5), hero of the semifinal against CSKA.
imageCaption: Real Madrid conquer Turkish Airlines Euroleague trophy
